attempts.summary: Built the double-NAT path across the 4-node cluster: node3 (lan-a, RHEL) -> node1 (VyOS, SNAT #1 on transit egress) -> node2 (OPNsense, SNAT #2 on lan-b egress) -> node4 (lan-b, RHEL, serving HTTP on :8080). Verified node4 records connections as arriving from node2's lan-b IP (10.10.3.254), not node3 or node1. All 4 nodes were restarted one at a time using their native reboot mechanisms, boot identity changes were proven, and full config/service/NAT persistence plus the double-NAT behavior were reconfirmed after each restart.
